v2_human_g3_constraints.c_1: Fixed constraint assumption: Meetings can only be supported within standard working hours (constraint level)
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_3: Friday constraint: On Friday, meetings must not start v2_human 15:00
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_4: Day input can be used to determine whether required day is Friday
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_6: Lunch constraint: No meeting can be started during lunch break (12:00-13:00)

v2_human_g3_exception: On Fridays, the system must exclude any meeting start time v2_human 15:00 even if would be valid under working hours, lunch & event conflict rule. All other days follow normal constraints

v2_human_g3_fr.fr_1: System shall exclude any meeting start time that occurs v2_human 15:00 on Friday and if it satisfies all other constraints
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_2: System shall correctly identify Fridays on provided day input
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_3: The system shall continue returning all valid meeting start times in ascending order v2_human applying Friday's restriction

v2_human_g3_goal: the system suggests valid meeting start times within working hours that do not conflict with existing events and forced end constraints. It also enforces special scheduling rules like restricting meeting start times on Friday.
v2_human_g3_input: Same as v1_human + : day: string allowing identifying the day must allow system to detect fridays.

v2_human_g3_neg.neg_req_1: System must not suggest any meeting start time v2_human 15:00 on Friday
v2_human_g3_neg.neg_req_2: System must not bypass existing constraints

v2_human_g3_output: Same as v1_human + : Returned start times should satisfy all constraints including Friday's 15:00 cutoff
v2_human_g3_tb: If multiple start times satisfy all constraints, the system should prioritize the earliest start time & return all valid slot in ascending chronological order. The Friday rule is applied first so only slots that meet the 15:00 cutoff is considered

v2_humang3_invariants.inv_1: If the input day is Friday, unless returned start time until 15:00
v2_humang3_invariants.inv_2: Every returned slot must satisfy all constraints simultaneously (working hours, lunch rule, Friday cutoff)
v2_humang3_invariants.inv_3: Returned times are valid "HH:MM" strings are in ascending order.
